purpose: Define exact required verification, conformance, certification, compatibility, security and performance evidence before a release candidate may be accepted.

topics.name: Release Acceptance Profile
topics.purpose: Define exact required verification, conformance, certification, compatibility, security and performance evidence before a release candidate may be accepted.

semantics.identity_rule: Each acceptance profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.scope_rule: Profile applies to exact product/module/release class.
semantics.threshold_rule: Required vs advisory evidence is explicit.
semantics.authorization_rule: Profile pass does not substitute for release approval authority.
semantics.deployment_rule: Release acceptance remains separate from deployment.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: acceptance profile inferred from version number
